author: jsign
content:
mmm i think the `count` might be a problem to fix the `excess` to get the fixed fee we want (IIUC you're referring to that bullet in my list?).
In `builder_exits` the fee also adds `count - target` within the block, and doesn't only wait until `excess` is updated. before the fork the `count` never resets, so that wouldn't guarantee the fixed fee.

And `count` is only reset to 0 in the system call in existing system contracts, so whenever the fork activates the first system call would add the count of all the registrations before the fork to `excess`.
